description.value: Participants categorized celebrity and non-famous faces by familiarity and performed a three-alternative forced-choice face-name matching task for famous faces.

instructions.value: Participants indicated whether each presented face was famous or not in block 1. In block 2, participants selected which of three names corresponded to the presented famous face.

stimuli.value: Photographs of 42 famous faces and 20 non-famous faces; famous faces were presented with two distractor names and one correct name.
